## Checks (see CONTRIBUTING.md and CLAUDE.md)

- [ ] No number, citation or quotation is invented; every figure traces to a script output or a verified source
- [ ] Claims use the wording table in `CLAUDE.md` section 6 (nothing says a road is safe, calibrated, or running on a phone)
- [ ] Pinned data is untouched; new data is in a new dated folder and `data/MANIFEST.md` is updated
- [ ] No thresholds were changed after seeing the results they produce (or it is recorded in a new ADR)
- [ ] No secrets, no Google Maps Platform data, no bulk use of `tile.openstreetmap.org`
- [ ] If a flaw was fixed or a claim contradicted, `KNOWN_FLAWS.md` / `DECISIONS.md` is updated
